services.desc: Our Private Helicopter & Lodge package is the closest you’ll get to having your own alpine playground. This is the pinnacle of heli-skiing excellence, crafted for groups seeking an exclusive experience from first tracks to fireside chats. Imagine an entire lodge (or luxury catamaran) as your basecamp, a dedicated team at your disposal, two expert guides, and a helicopter that’s ready when you are. With a set number of helicopter hours tailored to each location, we’ll optimize your experience based on daily conditions and your group’s preferences.
